column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: Look at the desert drown,\nIsaac. Your lighthouse did\nthis, and I'm only{page_break}watching.{end_wait}
Jenna, wait! Whatever they\ndid to you, we can undo it.\nCome back!{end_wait}
Undo it? Sweet Isaac, the\ngirl you want is ash on the\nwind.{end_wait}
Keep climbing your\nlighthouses. I'll be warm\nwhen they're lit.{end_wait}
